description: CHED-D (chedd-products) obligations. Each obligation declares what notification data must exist, under what conditions, and why. Schema paths are derived in features/notification-shape/04-migrate-chedd-products.md. Obligations own schema paths and conditions; the journey map owns presentation. CHED-D is food and feed of non-animal origin, so there is no veterinary, species-taxonomy, transporter, or CPH obligation.

obligations.name: Notification Type
obligations.rationale: Regulatory requirement to classify the import for routing to the correct inspection regime.

obligations.name: Consignment Origin
obligations.rationale: Traceability: country and region of origin determine the applicable rules and risk profile.

obligations.name: Import Purpose
obligations.rationale: Determines the regulatory pathway for the consignment.

obligations.name: Commodity Selection
obligations.rationale: Identifies the commodity being imported. The commodity code is the key fact that drives downstream variance.
obligations.note: Key fact: the commodity code drives commodity-conditional obligation activation via refdata.

obligations.name: Commodity Description
obligations.rationale: CED requires a free-text product description for each commodity line item.

obligations.name: Commodity Complement
obligations.rationale: Identifies the precise product complement (the combo selection) for each commodity.

obligations.name: Intended Use
obligations.rationale: Food and feed of non-animal origin must declare its intended use (human consumption, feedingstuff, further process, other) when the commodity is intended for the internal market.

condition.description: Active when the commodity's refdata has has_internal_market = true (absent on the 31 anomaly commodities).

obligations.name: Packages and Weights
obligations.rationale: Customs and inspection need the declared package count and gross/net weights, with per-line-item detail.

obligations.name: Entry Point and Arrival
obligations.rationale: Operational: the port of entry determines the BCP; arrival date and time trigger scheduling.

obligations.name: Transport to Port of Entry
obligations.rationale: Means of transport carrying the consignment to the port of entry.

obligations.name: Accompanying Documents
obligations.rationale: Commercial and regulatory documents that must accompany the consignment.

obligations.name: Consignor Identification
obligations.rationale: Supply chain traceability: identifies who is exporting the goods.

obligations.name: Consignee Identification
obligations.rationale: Supply chain traceability: identifies who is receiving the consignment.

obligations.name: Importer Identification
obligations.rationale: Legal liability: identifies the legal importer responsible for compliance.

obligations.name: Destination Identification
obligations.rationale: Where the consignment is delivered after clearing the border.

obligations.name: Importer Reference Number
obligations.rationale: The importer's own local reference for the consignment.

obligations.name: Contact Designation
obligations.rationale: Operational: nominated contact for the competent authority regarding this consignment.

obligations.name: Legal Declaration
obligations.rationale: Legal requirement: the importer assumes responsibility for accuracy and compliance.
obligations.action: Sets submittedAt and changes notification.status to SUBMITTED.
